A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MOON2.0, and their main text, equations, figures, and tables support comparison. Neither contains an appendix. v2 Sections 5.1 and 5.3 refer to supplementary baseline results and MoE analyses that are absent from the supplied PDFs, limiting assessment of those additions.

before.justification: v1 reports original retrieval, classification, and attribute-prediction experiments in Tables 1–3, component ablations in Table 4, and attention visualizations in Figure 7.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablation results, and attention visualizations. These qualify independently of its unavailable supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same modality-driven MoE, inter- and intra-product objectives, two-stage augmentation, mean pooling, and dynamic filtering. Revised explanations do not establish a change to the proposed algorithm or architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions use MBE2.0, M5Product, and Fashion200K for the same retrieval directions, classification, and attribute-prediction tasks. Naming Taobao clarifies the existing data source; the revised sample count does not establish different population or task coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 1–3 retain the same nine baselines. v2 Section 5.1 additionally reports fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 comparisons, but directs their results to unavailable supplementary material. Their participation as additional comparator variants cannot be verified against a reported results table.

E3.justification: The stated MBE2.0 test-set size changes from 966,241 to 636,241, while training remains at 5,751,594 samples. v2 also reports fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL and InternVL3 controls. The retained metrics and MOON2.0 training settings are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that existing tables were recomputed.

E4.justification: Table 4 retains the same four component ablations and values; the modality-mixture analysis and heatmap cases also remain. v2 Section 5.3 refers to further MoE-effectiveness analysis in missing supplementary material, preventing assessment of its question, evidence, or extent.

E5.justification: The supplied results retain point estimates without disclosed repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Asterisks in the comparison tables continue to indicate third-ranked results, not statistical significance.

E6.justification: Every numerical entry in Tables 1–4 matches across versions, and the visible qualitative findings remain the same. However, v2 refers to additional fine-tuned baseline results that are unavailable. Those result additions cannot be assessed, and identical table values do not establish identical evaluation conditions given the revised test-set count.

T1.justification: Equations 1–11 retain their mathematical content. Equation 11 renames the sigmoid-sharpness coefficient from alpha to kappa, distinguishing it from the regularization coefficient in Equation 8. No substantive definitions, derivations, assumptions, or proofs are added.

C1.justification: The introduction revises the benchmark contribution's stated scale from 6.7 million to 6.4 million samples. The central novelty, modality-balancing, zero-shot performance, and alignment claims remain. The benchmark-release claim already appeared in v1's introduction.

C2.justification: The explanations linking performance to expert specialization, intra-product alignment, augmentation, and noise filtering remain substantively unchanged. The detailed cardigan and brand-name heatmap interpretation already appears in v1 Section 5.4. No substantive limitations or applicability boundaries are added.

D1.justification: v2 adds an explicit MBE2.0 dataset-access URL, identifies Taobao as the source, and documents baseline normalization, last-layer mean pooling, a shared prompt, and common candidate sets. These improve implementation disclosure without establishing changes to the retained experiments.

R1.justification: v2 adds Cross-domain Product Representation Learning for Rich-content E-commerce, EMoE, and MentorNet, including targeted distinctions concerning objective coupling and dual-flow alignment. Numerous other reference changes update publication metadata for existing works rather than introduce new research.

P1.justification: v2 condenses the abstract, related work, method overview, augmentation/filtering explanations, and benchmark description. It merges Sections 4.1 and 4.2, clarifies acronym expansions and notation, and edits author information. The overall section sequence and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: The seven figures and four tables are retained. Figure 1 is enlarged, Figure 7 is reformatted and its erroneous 'Our DART' label becomes 'Our MOON2.0', and Tables 2–3 move between columns as the document reflows. These are presentation changes rather than new analyses.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves transparency and clarity through dataset-access information, explicit baseline encoding and prompt details, clearer notation, and the corrected Figure 7 label. The visible method and numerical evidence remain unchanged. The unexplained test-count revision and unavailable supplementary comparisons limit these gains: stronger empirical support cannot be credited from the supplied PDFs.
